text:
Sara Patel: FYI — AcmeHealth (cust-987) reporting Dedicated placement failures in us-east-1 since ~09:10 UTC. They see repeated 503 / placement_failed and some 429s. Ticket #12345. Pasting relevant logs and a repro below.

Rajesh Kumar: I'm oncall — assigning Sev2. Which dedicated pool is impacted? Any config changes deployed in the last hour?

Sara Patel: Pool: dedicated-prod-us-east-1-b. Customer reserved 4 GPUs, attempted burst to 8 for nightly batch jobs and that's when errors started. No scheduled config changes on our side except standard infra patching window.

InfraBot: autoscaler_event: {pool: dedicated-prod-us-east-1-b, event: scale_up_attempt, desired: 8, actual: 4, reason: GPU_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, time: 2024-11-15T09:11:22Z}

Lina Gomez: Looking at cluster metrics — total GPU capacity in us-east reduced (some hosts draining for kernel updates) + a recent Dedicated reservation bumped utilization to ~98%. We're seeing preemptions and allocation_timeouts. Pulling placement service logs now.

Mike Chen: Mitigation plan (short): 1) enable cross-region fallback for AcmeHealth to us-west-2 and attempt manual placement there; 2) temporarily allow burst to shared-hosted pool for small % of requests; 3) prepare customer advisory. I'll kick off manual placement now.

Rajesh Kumar: Can you paste a minimal repro we can run locally to observe the error? Also include the exact API error payloads.

Sara Patel: Repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/assign \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"cust-987","pool":"dedicated-prod-us-east-1-b","gpus":8,"timeout_secs":30}'
```
Response observed: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
```json
{
  "error": "placement_failed",
  "reason": "no_capacity_available",
  "details": "allocation_timeout after 30s; attempted hosts: 12; backoff_count: 3"
}
```
Also saw intermittent 429s during request queuing: `rate_limited - throttled_by_pool`

Lina Gomez: Repro matches placement log snippets:
```
[placement] INFO trying allocate cid=cust-987 gpus=8
[placement] WARN allocation_timeout cid=cust-987 hosts_considered=12
[placement] ERROR GPU_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED pool=dedicated-prod-us-east-1-b
```
Root cause hypothesis: combined impact of scheduled host drains + a noisy neighbor (single tenant occupying >50% of free capacity) + autoscaler backoff settings delaying scale up.

Lina Gomez: Current autoscaler config for the pool:
```yaml
pool: dedicated-prod-us-east-1-b
min_replicas: 10
max_replicas: 50
scale_up_cooldown: 60s
scale_down_cooldown: 300s
allocation_backoff: 120s
allocation_timeout: 30s
```
The allocation_backoff=120s is too aggressive for bursty customer requests; by the time backoff expires region is still starved.

Mike Chen: Short-term actions (next 1-3 hours):
- Reduce allocation_backoff to 30s for dedicated pools with high headroom churn.
- Enable automatic cross-region fallback for affected Dedicated customers (with opt-out).
- Perform manual placement to us-west-2 for AcmeHealth and notify them.
- Temporarily enable limited spillover to hosted cluster (~5% of tokens) to avoid customer-visible failures.

BillingBot: Flagged ticket #12345 for credits. Preliminary estimate: ~3 hours impacted, will prepare a draft credit note for customer success.

Rajesh Kumar: Follow-ups for postmortem:
- Add alert: region_capacity_headroom_us-east < 10% for >5m.
- Add anomaly detection for single-tenant GPU share > 40%.
- Re-evaluate autoscaler backoff strategy to allow reactive scale_up under short bursts.

Sara Patel: I'll draft customer advisory now: apology + description of mitigation + ask permission for cross-region failover. Will include timeline and credit offer.

Lina Gomez: Pushing hotfix to autoscaler config and placement anti-affinity rules (spread large jobs across hosts). Rolling change to dedicated-prod-us-east-1-b now. Monitoring logs.

InfraBot: deploy: autoscaler-config-update to dedicated-prod-us-east-1-b [ci-run-5567] — success.

Lina Gomez: After changes, observed placement success for the repro:
```
[placement] INFO allocation_success cid=cust-987 hosts_allocated=3 gpus_allocated=8 region=us-west-2
```
Latency and error rate trending down in the last 10m.

Mike Chen: Tell support to confirm with AcmeHealth that their jobs are running in us-west-2 and ask to validate latency and correctness. If they accept, we will keep them on fallback until us-east headroom is back to normal.

Sara Patel: Noted. Sending the advisory + asking for permission now. I'll update ticket with full notes and escalate for credits as BillingBot flagged.

Rajesh Kumar: Once customer confirms, we should run a short blameless postmortem: timeline, root cause (maintenance + noisy neighbor + backoff), mitigations implemented, follow-ups (alerts + autoscaler tuning + placement improvements).

Sara Patel: Thanks everyone — I'll close the incident thread after customer confirmation.
